bug_info.bug_desc: In the pre-merge code, hmac_core.idle_o was asserted only when the hmac_core FSM was in StIdle and no start/continue request was present. The hmac_core did not receive the stop command, so when software issued a stop during HMAC message processing, the core remained in StMsg after the current block boundary and its idle_o stayed deasserted. As a result, the top-level hmac idle_o also stayed low after a stop, preventing the module from being considered idle for clock gating and context save/restore.
bug_info.fix_hint: Pass reg_hash_stop_i into hmac_core and introduce a registered idle tracker. Deassert idleness on start/continue, assert it when the FSM is in StIdle, assert it when the FSM is in StMsg at a completed message block (txcnt_eq_blksz) with a pending stop request, and hold the previous idle state otherwise. This lets idle_o rise at the stop point even though the main FSM remains in StMsg for context switching.
